title: HUNT-0001 — Hessdalen Lights: event-family reality before explanation
motto: NOTHING SUPERNATURAL — ONLY NATURE NOT YET UNDERSTOOD.
why_first_native_hunt: Hessdalen is recurrent, instrumented, publicly documented and still interpretation-sensitive. It is therefore a strong first native TOPA test because the method can succeed by resolving, demoting or preserving uncertainty rather than by finding an extraordinary answer.
frozen_question: Does the public Hessdalen record establish a recurring source-bound event family that survives known-light, instrument, processing and source-dependence attacks strongly enough to justify a dedicated raw-data replication program?
claim_ceiling: This hunt may establish documentation quality, event-level residuals, failures of specific explanations and requirements for future measurements. It may not infer paranormal, extraterrestrial, intelligent, wormhole or unknown-physics causation merely from an unresolved light or instrument return.
observation_targets: historical visual reports with exact time/location when available
historical radar returns and their visual overlap
historical spectral, magnetic, RF, IR, radiation and seismic measurements
modern Blue Box camera products and stated processing artifacts
availability of raw video and cross-sensor timing

competing_hypotheses.H0_HETEROGENEOUS_CONVENTIONAL: Most or all Hessdalen-labelled events are a mixture of aircraft, satellites, stars/planets, meteors, local lights, atmospheric effects, optical artifacts, processing artifacts and classification error rather than one phenomenon.
competing_hypotheses.H1_RECURRENT_LOCAL_NATURAL: A subset is a recurrent local natural luminous/atmospheric/geophysical phenomenon with repeatable measurable properties.
competing_hypotheses.H2_INSTRUMENT_PROCESSING: Some apparently anomalous modern events are caused or amplified by camera geometry, lens reflections, compression, stacking, triggering or other instrument/processing effects.
competing_hypotheses.H3_ENGINEERED_ORDINARY: A subset is caused by ordinary engineered systems such as aircraft, drones, satellites, searchlights or other terrestrial emitters.
competing_hypotheses.H4_EXTRAORDINARY: A subset requires an extraordinary physical or intelligent explanation. This lane is admitted only as a falsifiable competitor and receives no default prior advantage.

frozen_gates.pass: At least one event has source-bound contemporaneous documentation with enough time/location information to distinguish occurrence from later retelling.
At least one event has temporally compatible observations on two physically distinct channels, with each channel's limitations preserved.
frozen_gates.guard: MULTI_CHANNEL != MULTI_SOURCE and does not by itself establish common cause.

frozen_gates.pass: Repeated events show a stable measurable feature set across sessions after known-source and artifact exclusion.
frozen_gates.fail: Residuals remain heterogeneous or are too data-poor to justify one phenomenon label.

frozen_gates.pass: Raw or minimally processed data plus calibration/timing metadata are available for independent replay of at least one high-value event.
frozen_gates.fail: Only screenshots, stacks, summaries or witness prose are available.

frozen_gates.pass: A specific extraordinary model makes a frozen prediction that outperforms conventional competitors on independent holdout data.
frozen_gates.fail: Unresolved data are used as the argument.
